text: Oh no! Hi, captain! I'm Pip! And I'm Pop! We're twins! We were feeding our pets, and somebody left the space gate open. Whoops!
Lost pets. Fluff the moon-bunny, Splodge the jelly-pup and Zoom the comet-cat ran away. And a pirate grabbed Wiggles the star-snail!
Bring them home. Their planets are marked on your map. For Wiggles, you'll have to chase that pirate away. Please hurry, captain. Pets get hungry!
All home! Fluff! Splodge! Zoom! Wiggles! You found them all! Look, they're having a big snuggle pile. Even Wiggles, and he's very slow.
Best captain ever. Here's your reward, captain, and a pet collar with your name on it. We'll keep the gate shut from now on. Promise!
